start.description: I moved out of my apartment on June 30, 2026 when my lease ended. My deposit was $1,000. I had texted them my new address. I got a letter from the landlord by certified mail on August 24, 2026 (it's dated August 20, 2026) saying they're keeping $700 for cleaning and painting. That's almost two months after I left. The letter tells me to object in writing within 15 days, and I have not sent them anything back.

chat: They sent this letter like 2 months after I moved out. Can they still keep my money?
Has this happened to other people? Did a judge ever make the landlord give the money back when the letter came late?
So that means I get my $700 back, right?
Who pays for a lawyer if I take them to court over this?
